Police are investigating a suspected arson attack after a fire broke out on City Hill in Civic late on Wednesday night.

Login or signup to continue reading

According to the ACT Emergency Services Agency, the blaze was reported around midnight, with ACT Fire & Rescue crews attending the scene to extinguish the flames.

The fire and plumes of rising smoke were visible from a distance across the city centre late on Wednesday.

ACT Policing confirmed it was aware of fires on City Hill overnight.

"The fires are suspected to have been deliberately lit. Investigations into the incident are ongoing," a police spokesperson said.

Anyone with information regarding the incident is urged to contact Crime Stoppers on 1800 333 000, quoting reference P2503655.
